method.micro: Five sequential trials per platform, 200 serializations of each deterministic fixture. Reference serializer byte parity and matching payload hashes. C++ new counters exclude direct C malloc. Baseline then candidate on a shared workstation, not randomized cross-build timing.
method.http: Four fresh Windows processes per source, alternating detailed/compact order, 100 real loopback MCP calls per action. Counters include HTTP client, server and background C++ allocations; coordinator process-exit verified. Not a public-network/model-time or leak-freedom claim.

pairedHttpFollowup.reason: Initial sequential HTTP timings were slower despite the isolated serializer improvement. Reused the exact retained executables in alternating source/phase order.
